hypotheses.Q0_role_factorization_recomposes_attenti: Q1/K1/Q2/K2/value VJPs recompose native attention with maximum relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.Q1_qk_routing_is_sufficient: Near-eight QK reaches median gradient cosine at least 0.90 and finite direction at least 0.95 in every source layer.
hypotheses.Q2_qk_retains_full_program_effect: Near-eight QK retains at least 85 percent of the near-eight full program's mean finite effect in every source layer.
hypotheses.Q3_value_alone_is_insufficient: Near-eight value-only gradient cosine is below 0.85 in every source layer.
hypotheses.Q4_queries_and_keys_are_complementary: Combined QK exceeds both query-only and key-only by at least 0.05 gradient cosine in every source layer.
hypotheses.Q5_two_tensor_factors_are_complementary: Combined QK exceeds both Q1K1 and Q2K2 by at least 0.05 gradient cosine in every source layer.
hypotheses.Q6_qk_recovers_causal_support: Near-eight QK top-64 support Jaccard against the exact selector is at least 0.25 in every source layer.
